title: Global Semiconductor Sales Outpace Last Year through First Quarter of 2013
主要内容: Global semiconductor sales rose 1.1% in March 2013 to $23.48 billion, up from $23.23 billion in February. Year-over-year, sales increased 0.9% compared to March 2012. First-quarter sales also rose 0.9% from the same period in 2012. Asia Pacific and Europe saw growth of 6.9% and 0.7%, respectively, while the Americas declined 1.5% and Japan fell sharply by 18%. The Japanese yen's devaluation contributed to the decline in Japan. Europe's sales increased 5.7% month-over-month, the largest sequential rise since March 2010. The Semiconductor Industry Association (SIA) highlighted the importance of the semiconductor industry in driving economic growth and innovation.
